title: One Call Ahead: Packed Self-Speculative Decoding with Diffusion Drafting
abstract: arXiv:2610.33379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) language models generate tokens sequentially, so generating long outputs is costly. Speculative decoding mitigates this by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens for the target AR model to verify in parallel, while a diffusion-based drafter can produce an entire draft block in one forward pass. In models with AR and diffusion modes, one network both drafts and verifies, but drafting still waits for verification, so the standard schedule needs two sequential model calls per iteration. Existing one-call schedules avoid the wait but incur input size quadratic in the speculative width. Motivated by this efficiency bottleneck, we introduce Packed-SS, a self-speculative decoding schedule that verifies and drafts in a single model call with input size linear in the speculative width, while preserving the target model's distribution. The key idea is to let the diffusion drafter run one call ahead: while verify

translated_title: 抢先一步调用：基于扩散起草的打包式自投机解码
translated_abstract: 自回归（AR）语言模型按顺序生成词元，因此生成长输出的成本很高。投机解码通过使用轻量级起草器提出多个词元、供目标AR模型并行验证来缓解这一问题，而基于扩散的起草器可以在一次前向传播中生成整个草稿块。在同时具备AR和扩散模式的模型中，同一个网络既负责起草又负责验证，但起草仍需等待验证完成，因此标准调度方案每次迭代需要两次顺序模型调用。现有的一次调用调度方案避免了这种等待，但其输入大小会随投机宽度呈二次方增长。受这一效率瓶颈的启发，我们提出了Packed-SS，一种自投机解码调度方案，它在单次模型调用中同时完成验证与起草，输入大小随投机宽度仅呈线性增长，同时保持目标模型的分布。其关键思想是让扩散起草器“抢先一步调用”：在验证的同时……
tldr: 提出Packed-SS自投机解码调度方案，通过让扩散起草器“抢先一步调用”，在单次模型调用中同时完成验证与起草，且输入大小随投机宽度仅呈线性增长，同时保持目标模型的输出分布。
en_tdlr: Packed-SS, a self-speculative decoding schedule that lets the diffusion drafter run one call ahead, verifies and drafts in a single model call with input size linear in the speculative width while preserving the target model's distribution.
